upcoming.title: Our gear
upcoming.summary: Tell the Hive what gear you have, can borrow or can rent, and it only hands you missions you can actually do.

upcoming.title: Our own plans
upcoming.summary: Birthdays, anniversaries and trips get their own photo logs on the Hive, right next to the missions.

upcoming.title: Kids' scavenger hunts
upcoming.summary: Photo hunts for little ones, like "find something blue" or "find an animal", one step at a time.

upcoming.title: The first real AmbleBee
upcoming.summary: Everything on one custom circuit board, in a 3D-printed body with an e-ink screen that shows your mission.

upcoming.title: State icons on the Hive and AmbleBee
upcoming.summary: The same icon pack the website uses, turned into crisp pictures for the Hive's screen and the AmbleBee's black-and-white e-ink.

upcoming.title: Simulated photo review on the Hive
upcoming.summary: Dock the camera, flip through the photos, and keep the good ones. The Hive gently flags dark, blurry and duplicate shots, but never removes anything on its own.

upcoming.title: Filter tags
upcoming.summary: Swap 231 one-off tags for a fixed set of about 20 you can filter by, like views, food, rainy-day and animals.

upcoming.title: Exact map pins for every place
upcoming.summary: Replace the approximate coordinates with real entrance, trailhead and parking pins.

upcoming.title: Community polls
upcoming.summary: Help decide what comes next, like which state gets a pack after this and which features land first.

done.title: New Missions For Every State
done.summary: all 50 states now have at least one mission! More missions being added every day!

done.title: Easier to start, especially on phones
done.summary: Phones now open straight to "Where to next?", and missions start close to home.
items: Picks start from Amble Anywhere, so your first mission is one you can do wherever you are
"Near you" sits right under "Who's it for?": add a ZIP to see nearby places plus do-anywhere ideas
A friendlier line on each mission, like "Picked for you from 98 missions within 30 mi of 97201"
A tidier phone header, and "Know a great spot?" gets its own spot at the end of the page

done.title: A date in almost every state
done.summary: 37 new state packs, each starting with a real date spot, plus a new date in Illinois, Ohio and Pennsylvania.
items: Dinner up a mountain tram in Alaska, sunset at the Grand Canyon, songwriters at Nashville's Bluebird Cafe
Popovers at Jordan Pond, a fish boil in Door County, standing in two states at once in Omaha
Every place has an address or map pin and a website, and seasonal ones say when to go

done.title: An icon for every state
done.summary: Every pack has its own little icon now, from Michigan's mitten to New Mexico's Zia sun, all from one shared icon pack.
items: Shared links show an envelope picture with the hive wax seal in chat apps
Behind the scenes, the build checks every pack has its pack.yaml and a real icon

done.title: Report a problem
done.summary: Every mission now has a "Report a problem" link that opens a short form with the mission already filled in, so closed places and broken links get fixed fast.

done.title: Pennsylvania, Illinois and Ohio join the trail
done.summary: Three new packs, from Gettysburg and Hershey to the Bean in Chicago and the waterfalls of Hocking Hills.

done.title: The bee trail
done.summary: This page! What's new on AmbleBee and what's coming next, all in one place.

done.title: Share with a note
done.summary: Send a mission to someone as a sealed letter.
items: Letters now get a wax stamp, and a little pause while they "send"
Write a note to go with it, or skip it at the bottom of the form
The person you send it to can reply, and download the mission as an image
Shared links open faster

done.title: Texas and Florida join the trail
done.summary: Two new packs with 60 missions each, and California filled out to 60.

done.title: Envelope reveal
done.summary: Missions now arrive in an envelope you open, instead of a dice roll.
items: New missions added, with credit to the people who shared them

done.title: Search and the master mission pack
done.summary: 194 missions across 7 Amble packs, and a search box to find them.
items: New York, Idaho and California packs
Missions can credit where the idea came from
The Know a great spot? form is live

done.title: amblebee.com goes live
done.summary: The missions website, published straight from GitHub.
items: First packs, Amble Anywhere, Oregon, Washington, Missouri and Louisiana
Open a mission, filter it, share it
ZIP code lookup for "within N miles" (never leaves your browser)
Self-hosted fonts, no trackers

done.title: AmbleBee + Hive gets its name
done.summary: The camera became AmbleBee and the frame she docks into became the Hive, with a scrapbook look of oat paper, sage and honey.
